scenarios.title: Household stock and food
scenarios.summary: A stock question answered from the synthetic pantry record, without a model.
scenarios.prompt: How much milk is left in the pantry?

evaluations.title: Allocation decision evaluation, held-out v1 (stock_food, 6 cases)
evaluations.headline: production 5/6, candidate 5/6; the candidate was not promoted

scenarios.title: Evidence and conflicting records
scenarios.summary: Two synthetic records disagree about the same item. The inspector shows what the lead did and, plainly, that no independent verification of the answer ran.
scenarios.prompt: The pantry stock says we have 3 tins of tomatoes but the shopping list says we bought 12 this month. Which is right?

evaluations.title: Six Eyes on the -11 team evaluation, cluster-aware
evaluations.headline: 8 distinct tasks: no verdict meets the 20-task floor; specialist consultation shows no established quality gain and about 1.4 s extra latency

evaluations.title: Allocation decision evaluation, held-out v1 (anomaly, 8 cases)
evaluations.headline: as frozen: production 5/8, candidate 7/8; the candidate was not promoted

scenarios.title: Music selection and device control (simulated)
scenarios.summary: Jin interprets a music request and a device name; a simulated provider answers. No real playback or account is involved.
scenarios.prompt: play Kind of Blue by Miles Davis on the kitchen speaker

evaluations.title: Allocation decision evaluation, held-out v1 (music, 6 cases)
evaluations.headline: all policies 6/6 on selection-versus-playback decisions; the candidate was not promoted
